result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The fix is one filter in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (around line 6514): the subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, matching the other purchase-order queries. I also added a sentence to its Javadoc saying cancelled purchase orders are not counted.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: the `purchaseOrder` helper takes a status (the old signature delegates with `SENT`), and a new test `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` reproduces your example: Anna gets 2, Bob gets 1.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest`, `QuarterPurchaseOrdersTest`, `LatestPurchaseOrdersTest` and `DashboardTest` pass offline. Nothing is committed.
